desc:
Chapter 3 is here!!
Like and favourite the game for more chapters!!!

Story: After your grandma's disappearance you arrive at the abandoned nursing home where she previously lived in hopes of finding her.

WARNING!
This experience contains Sudden jumpscares, Flashing lights, and Loud noises.

Includes Mobile & Console, and even VR support!!!

Controls:
` - Open Inventory
RMB - change glowstick color
LShift - Sprint
CTRL - Free mouse mode
H - Open Map

Join our roblox group to receive in-game perks!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/35835161
Also, join our community server for updates & to report bugs!
